About the atlas

A community-maintained map of metabolomics tools and transferable protocols.

Purpose

The Metabolomics Tool Atlas is a living map of both the tools researchers use and the published, transferable protocols that combine those resources into practical strategies.

It supports two complementary questions: Which tool can perform this task? and How have researchers combined tools and experimental steps to solve this problem?

Two connected content types

  • Tools: software, packages, services, databases, spectral libraries, repositories, and executable workflows.
  • Protocols: published experimental or computational strategies that can be transferred beyond one application study.

What inclusion means

Inclusion documents that a resource or protocol is within scope. It is not an endorsement, certification, or ranking.
